description: Validates that trade loops are only recommended after docking at ports

tests.name: Fixture: clear the player's prior port knowledge

data.sql: DELETE FROM player_known_ports WHERE player_id = (SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name = 'loop_player')

tests.name: Choose a connected two-way port pair

data.sql: SELECT p1.port_id, p1.sector_id, p2.port_id, p2.sector_id FROM ports p1 JOIN sector_warps sw ON sw.from_sector = p1.sector_id JOIN sector_warps back ON back.from_sector = sw.to_sector AND back.to_sector = sw.from_sector JOIN ports p2 ON p2.sector_id = sw.to_sector AND p2.port_id > p1.port_id WHERE p1.is_active AND p2.is_active ORDER BY p1.port_id, p2.port_id LIMIT 1

tests.name: Fixture: configure a two-way ORE market on the selected ports

data.sql: WITH selected AS (SELECT port_id FROM ports WHERE port_id IN (@{route_port_a_id}, @{route_port_b_id})), normalized AS (UPDATE port_trade pt SET mode = 'buy' FROM selected s WHERE pt.port_id = s.port_id AND pt.commodity = 'ORE' RETURNING pt.port_id), inserted AS (INSERT INTO port_trade (port_id, maxproduct, commodity, mode) SELECT DISTINCT port_id, 1000000, 'ORE', 'sell' FROM normalized RETURNING port_id) SELECT count(*) FROM inserted

tests.name: Move test player and ship to the selected first port

data.sql: WITH target AS (SELECT player_id, ship_id FROM players WHERE name = 'loop_player'), known AS (DELETE FROM player_known_ports WHERE player_id = (SELECT player_id FROM target)), moved AS (UPDATE players p SET sector_id = @{route_sector_a_id} FROM target WHERE p.player_id = target.player_id RETURNING p.ship_id) UPDATE ships s SET sector_id = @{route_sector_a_id} FROM moved WHERE s.ship_id = moved.ship_id
